summary: Require EKODI AI to treat search, RAG, connected-source research, memory and model output as candidate evidence rather than verified external fact, with source authority, freshness, contradiction, scope and citation gates before material factual assertions.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform owner explicitly approved construction of the proposed Knowledge Claim Gate after the operational AI Claim Integrity rollout on 2026-09-23.
runtimeEnforcement: ai-knowledge-claim.js classifies knowledge-sensitive tasks and evaluates source authority, freshness, scope, independence and contradictions
ai-control-core.js preserves normalized knowledge evidence and injects deterministic gate verdict/source tokens into origin synthesis
ai-control-provider-router.js applies Knowledge Claim Gate before the operational Claim Integrity Gate
config/knowledge-source-registry.json binds retrieval provenance to the claim gate
AGENTS.override.md and ORCHESTRATOR_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT.md make retrieval-is-not-verification provider-neutral
deploy-ai-control.yml validates and promotes the gate through the existing immutable guarded AI Control release
rollback: If the runtime gate creates a material regression, revert the runtime classification/router integration to the last known-good guarded release while retaining the constitutional rule. Repair classification or evidence projection, rerun knowledge-claim, constitution, orchestration and AI Control tests, then re-promote. Never roll back to treating retrieval or model output as self-verifying fact.
verification: Run knowledge-claim unit/contract tests, constitution validation, orchestration validation, full repository regression tests, isolated AI Control staging deployment, guarded production promotion, and real production endpoint verification.
approvalEvidence: Owner instruction in this conversation plus constitution-approved label on PR #2425 before this verification rerun.
